config._about: Moving-link and bench rows, attempt 5. The a3 reviewer's rows (cad/review/a3/review_rows.json), adapted to the attempt-5 stops (four M3 screws ride on the link, their heads act on the block), and the a4 reviewer's step-14 rows (cad/review/a4/review_rows.json) adapted to the bench re-snug. Run on check_moving.blend, which to_cadcheck.py writes with each cartridge split into PRT_cartfix_* (fixed) and PRT_movlink_* (moving), and the right cartridge group copied into the stop-setting cradle 250 mm outboard: cad check cad/blender/check_moving.blend cad/blender/checks_moving.json OUT --only slide,distances,sightlines
